c/o Editora Guanabara
132 rua Ouvidor
Rio.
letter Nr. 9 from Rio

Rio, 16.10.40

Dear Hanna and Manfred,
There is not much to write to-day. We had a very
pleasant and extremely quiet week in the mountains where
Stefan got all his favourite dishes, where he could work
quietly and where we had nice people to talk if we wanted
to. Now we try to accustom our ears again to the noise of
Rio and think of the noise you must endure. We expect to
have a very lively week before going to Buenos Aires and will
probably have a rather hectic time there. In the middle of
November we intend to be in Montevideo and by the end
of December in New York where Eva is the only attraction.
We hope that you all have not too bad a time
and could good wishes help, England would have won already.
Stefan is trying to get a visa for his friend Friedenthal here and
maybe even a modest job, but he does not know how to
communicate with him, and then vises have become almost as
difficult here as in America, or even more so as there are no
rules but only silent restrictions.

Kindest regards to all, kisses to you both,
Lotte

Mr. Landan wrote me from Buenos Aires this week that he had sent
the signed affidavit forms for Mr. Mayer by registered air-mail. They
should arrive before this letter - I do not know at which address
and I hope that this will remove the last difficulties as appa-
rently the cabled affidavits were not accepted.

[Randnotiz links, vertikal geschrieben:]
Dear, please tell [?] because that I will speak with any friend - as far as I know he has not much
[?] from the distance and he would have offered [?] his help seeing how we get every day
cables and letters to diverse visas for South America. Till now I have not been able by the coastal travelly
to come in touch with the right people and we have to get our own for Argent - and the States - all be
the best strength for
those who are the
nearest to you. Please
unless that you
died is for away
we are glad she
is safe and would
be happy to
know you both
nearer to us.

Yours Stefan
From Friedenthal?
heart nothing and
I do not know his
address; it would be
important to know it.
